paite: Hichibang in Toupa PATHIAN in ahon ensak a; en dih ua, nipithei bawm na hi hi.
heading: Nipithei Bawm Muhna
english: Thus the Lord Yahweh showed me: behold, a basket of summer fruit.

paite: Ama'n, "Amos, bang ahia na muh?" achi a. Ke'n, "Nipithei bawm," ka chi hi. TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Ka mi Israelte tung ah tawpna ahong tungta; amaute gawtna ding ah ka lungsim ka kheng nawn kei ding hi, chi in.
english: He said, “Amos, what do you see?” I said, “A basket of summer fruit.” Then Yahweh said to me, “The end has come on my people Israel. I will not again pass by them any more.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in, huai ni chiang in tempul a lasakte dahna la ahi ding a; mun chih ah siluang tampi a-om ding a, dai dide in apaikhe ding uh," achi hi.
english: The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh. “The dead bodies will be many. In every place they will throw them out with silence.

paite: Hiai ngaikhia in, aw tasamte ne bei nuam a; gam a migentheite hihmang nuamte aw,
heading: Israel Tunggikna
english: Hear this, you who desire to swallow up the needy, and cause the poor of the land to fail,

paite: "Buh ka zuaktheihna ding un chikchiang a kha thak bei ding a, tangbuang buh ka zuaktheihna ding ua chikchiang a Sabbath ni bei ding ahia, chi in; Ephah hihneu a shekel hihlian, dikloupi a bukna khemna in na zang ua,
english: saying, ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may market wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel large, and dealing falsely with balances of deceit;

paite: huchi a dangkasik a migentheite lei a, tasamte khedap buh khat a i lei a, buhsi i zuaktheihna ding in,” chi in.
english: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of sandals, and sell the sweepings with the wheat?’”

paite: TOUPA, Jakob thupina sial in akichiam a, “Pel lou in anasep himhim ka mangngilh het kei ding," chi in.
english: Yahweh has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their works.

paite: Hiai ziak in gam pumpi ling in asung a om peuhmahte alungkham kei ding ua hia? Ahi, tui lian bang in ahong khang vek ding a; Aigupta gam lui bang in ahong buai in akiam ding hi.
english: Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and it will be stirred up and sink again, like the River of Egypt.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in, huai ni chiang in, hichi ahong hi ding a, sun lai in ni ka tumsak ding a, nisat lai in lei ka mialsak ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.

paite: Na ankuangluite uh lungkhamna leh na la tengteng uh kahna ka suaksak ding a; kawng tengteng sai-ip puan ka tengsak ding a, lu chih sip ah giauna ka hon tungsak ding; tapa tang neih suunna ding in lungkhamna leh atawpna khatna ni bang in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all your bodies, and baldness on every head. I will make it like the mourning for an only son, and its end like a bitter day.

paite: “Toupa PATHIAN in, ngai dih ua, nite ahong tung lellel; huai ni chiang in gam ah kial ka sawl ding a, an kialna hilou, tui a kialna hi sam lou, TOUPA thu theihna kialna pen," achi hi.
english: Behold, the days come,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing Yahweh’s words.

paite: Huan tuipi a kipan tuipi ah leh mal a kipan suahlam ah leng avakvai ding ua; TOUPA thu zong ding in ning chih ah atai ding ua, amu kei ding uh.
english: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east; they will run back and forth to seek Yahweh’s word, and will not find it.

paite: Huai ni chiang in nungak siangthou leh tangvalte dangtak in abah ding uhi.
english: In that day the beautiful virgins and the young men will faint for thirst.

paite: "Samaria khelhna sial a kichiam a, 'Aw Dan, na Pathian ahin bang in' leh 'Beer-sheba Lampi ahin bang in' chi, huai mite leng apuk ding ua, athounawn het kei ding uh,” achi hi.
english: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, ‘As your god, Dan, lives,’ and, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives,’ they will fall, and never rise up again.”
